# Medipyxis Help

> Help center for Medipyxis, the wound care EMR and practice management platform for mobile wound care teams.

Each What's new page shows a feature in short silent videos, with a text description of every video, plain answers to common questions, and the date it was last updated. Main site: https://medipyxis.com (see https://medipyxis.com/llms.txt).

## What's new, in video

- [How does Medipyxis handle rounding at a skilled nursing facility?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/snf-rounding/): Medipyxis runs wound care rounding at skilled nursing and assisted living facilities from start to finish: set up the facility as a building, book every resident's visit for the day, see each resident, bill the visit with the facility on the claim, and send the facility its signed notes.
- [How do I move my practice's patient data into Medipyxis?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/practice-data-import/): Practice Onboarding imports patient records from a prior EHR across 9 guided steps (1. Patients, 2. Insurance, 3. Medications, 4. Allergies, 5. Conditions, 6. Emergency Contacts, 7. Wounds, 8. Documents & Historical Wound Photos, 9. Past Visits). Every row is checked before saving (with PATIENT_IDENTITY_COLLISION quarantine when secondary identifiers conflict), problem rows are skipped with a reason, and results CSVs give each patient and wound its Medipyxis ID (patient_uid, wound_uid). Step 8 stores clinical PDFs/TIFFs in patient-documents and historical wound photos in wound-images under historical/; imported visits are read-only history.

## Help sections

- [Getting started](https://help.medipyxis.com/getting-started/): Logging in, setup and the dashboard by role
- [Modules](https://help.medipyxis.com/modules/): Visit wizard, billing, CRM, Fleet Calendar, referrals, inventory and more
- [Admin and billing](https://help.medipyxis.com/admin/): Practice, facility, user and billing setup (including [Practice Onboarding importer](https://help.medipyxis.com/admin/practice-onboarding/) and [Practice Data Import CSV templates and column reference](https://help.medipyxis.com/admin/practice-onboarding-csv-reference/))
- [Release notes](https://help.medipyxis.com/release-notes/): Every user-facing change, by month
